name: fade
note: A hover fade through an already-translucent child: a box at opacity 0.5 whose only child is rgba(0,0,255,0.5), over the white page. Subtree compositing blends the child into the surface first, so the effective coverage is 0.75 of blue — if opacity were flattened into the child's alpha the result would differ (the two alphas would multiply into the color rather than composite once).
